name: Notification centre
summary: A bell button with an unread count that opens a panel of recent notifications.
description:
Use it in an app's top bar for comments, assignments, deploys and invites: things that happened while the person was elsewhere. For something that needs attention right now, use a toast or a banner instead.

The bell is a .v-notify button with a .v-notify-count badge; the panel is a .v-popover.v-notifications, so it opens and light-dismisses natively. Unread items carry data-unread and a visually hidden "Unread" label (data-unread-label). data-v-notifications marks items read as they are followed, or all at once, and keeps the badge, the bell's accessible name and the empty line in step, including when your code adds items live.

classes.name: v-notify
classes.description: On the icon button that opens the panel: room for the count badge.

classes.name: v-notify-count
classes.description: The unread count on the bell, aria-hidden (the number is in the button's aria-label). Hidden at zero; shows 99+ above 99.

classes.name: v-notifications
classes.description: On a .v-popover with role="dialog" and aria-labelledby on its title: the panel.

classes.name: v-notifications-head
classes.description: The title and the "Mark all as read" button.

classes.name: v-notification
classes.description: One item, on an <li>. data-unread marks it unread.

classes.name: v-notification-link
classes.description: The link that fills the item: an avatar, the text and a time.

classes.name: v-notification-time
classes.description: When it happened, under the text.

classes.name: v-notifications-empty
classes.description: The line shown when the list is empty, such as "You're all caught up."

classes.name: v-notifications-foot
classes.description: A link to the full notifications page.

states.description: On a .v-notification: unread, tinted with a dot. Remove it to mark the item read.
On a .v-sr-only span at the start of an unread item's text, saying "Unread: ". The JS removes it when the item is read.
On the bell: the name without unread items (default "Notifications"). data-label-unread sets the name with them; {n} is the count.
Set on the panel by the JS: "true" shows the empty line.

hooks.name: data-v-notifications
hooks.description: Marks an item read when its link is followed, keeps the badge, the bell's name and the empty line in step, and fires v:read.

hooks.name: data-v-notifications-read
hooks.description: Marks every item read. Disabled when nothing is unread.

events.name: v:read
events.description: Fires after items are marked read, so you can tell the server.

keyboard.action: On the bell, opens the panel.
Moves through "Mark all as read", the notifications and the footer link.
Closes the panel and returns focus to the bell.

a11y: The bell's accessible name carries the count ("Notifications, 3 unread"), so the badge itself is aria-hidden.
Unread is said in words by a visually hidden label, not only shown by the tint and dot.
The panel is role="dialog" with a heading, because it holds links and a button, not menu items.
New notifications are not announced on their own: if one is urgent, raise a toast as well.

examples.title: Inbox of updates
examples.description: Open the bell, follow one notification, then mark the rest as read.
